fomod.Name: CyberpunkVRPort
fomod.Description:
6-DoF VR for Cyberpunk 2077: stereo rendering through OpenXR, head tracking, motion controllers merged into the game's own gamepad input, VRIK arms, and gameplay mods for HUD placement, holsters, melee, weapon handling and smoking.
Requires RED4ext, Cyber Engine Tweaks, redscript, ArchiveXL, TweakXL, Codeware 1.20 or newer, Equipment-EX, Visual Holsters and Nova Optics. An OpenXR runtime must be started before the game; it ships with your headset software.
